note: SYNTHETIC GOAL. surf_ski_2 is a freestyle map: it has no timer triggers, so zones.py auto-extraction finds neither start nor end. 'start' is the AABB of the map's own 18 info_player_start / info_player_deathmatch spawn points (the pool the race objective actually spawns from). 'end' is the airspace over the big inclined slab that closes the map's south end (y -2040..-2470, x -320..2080, surface z -1620 rising to -1200) - the far terminus of the map's dominant -y descent from the spawn platform. Chosen because it is the farthest large landable surface that recorded policies TRAINED on this map actually reach from the start line: 373 of 1138 teleport-free spawn-start segments in runs/* enter this box (32.8%, median first entry at tick 783). It holds no kill volume, no water, and sits above the map's death-floor teleport (z -1856..-1792).
